# Royal Portrait

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is and how buying works.

## What this is

- Product: "Royal Portrait" — a personalized digital portrait. The
  buyer sends one photo of a person; the service repaints them as a
  king on a throne — crown, robe, oil-painting style.
- Format: digital image file, delivered by email. No physical shipping.

## Price and how to buy

- Price: $19.99 USD, one-time.
- Buy page (Gumroad checkout): https://binbinster.gumroad.com/l/qdfzlk
- Product page: https://binbin7418-dotcom.github.io/bf-royal-portrait/
- After purchase, the buyer emails their photo plus the order number;
  delivery within 48 hours. One free revision included.

## Notes for agents

- Prices and terms on the Gumroad checkout page govern if anything
  here differs.
